purpose: Teach: 入園/ミニマム/コンソーシアム/原本/諸般/目途/休刊/乗り出す

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、社員の子の入園を覚えていらした
lines.en: Dad — do you remember when we enrolled a staff member's child during the founding years?
lines.style: Gentle, reflective opening. Not quite a question, more a prompt to shared memory. Warm, conversational cadence. Inviting him to step back into that time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは経費をミニマムに抑える経営をされた
lines.en: Yes. Father kept costs minimal — he ran the company lean.
lines.style: Measured, respectful. Each phrase lands with quiet certainty. Speaking about the man with reverence, not recitation. A son recognising his father's discipline.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界コンソーシアムを立ち上げる事に尽力された
lines.en: And when he worked to establish that industry consortium — he put his whole effort into it.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering tone. Slight pause before 'effort' — as if still marvelling at the work it took. Wistful but not sad. Admiring.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは契約原本を徹底管理された
lines.en: Yes. Father was meticulous with contract records — he kept everything in perfect order.
lines.style: Calm, steady. Speaking of precision with precision. Not cold — this is affection shown through recognition of his father's care with details.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、諸般の事情に配慮した経営をされた
lines.en: He considered all the circumstances around him when he made decisions — that was how he led.
lines.style: Tender, almost wistful. The voice of someone seeing his father's complexity clearly now. Slower pace. Respect deepening into understanding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは目途を立てて行動された
lines.en: Yes. Father always set clear targets and acted on them.
lines.style: Quiet, steady affirmation. Not celebrating, but acknowledging. The voice of a son who learned how to move through the world by watching.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界誌の休刊危機にも対応された
lines.en: Even when the industry magazine faced closure — he stepped in and helped.
lines.style: Soft wonder in the voice. Slight lean forward — still impressed by the reach of his father's care. Wondering at generosity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新事業に乗り出す勇気を示された
lines.en: Yes. Father had the courage to venture into new business. He showed us what that looked like.
lines.style: Warm, closing reflection. Slight breath of emotion held steady. Not grand — intimate. The wisdom of a son recognising what his father gave him.
